name: Bubble Beat
author: Cyberdelia
help: Bubbles hang from a ceiling that comes down to the beat of your music. Turn the wheel to aim, press Select to shoot and Play to swap your two bubbles. Three or more of a colour together pop, and whatever they held up falls too. Shoot on the beat and the pop counts double, on the first beat of a bar triple. Clear the field before a bubble hangs below the line. Without music, or when no beat is found, the ceiling comes down every few shots instead.

options.name: aiming
options.title: Aiming
options.help: Spin: turning the wheel turns the launcher, finely; Prev and Next nudge it. Thumb: the launcher points where your thumb rests on the wheel.

options.name: beat
options.title: Beat bonus
options.help: On: the game listens to your music, the ceiling comes down with its bars and shots on the beat score more. Off: the ceiling comes down every few shots and the music is just music.

options.name: marks
options.title: Colour marks
options.help: A small mark on every bubble, a different one for each colour, for telling them apart without the colours.

achievements.name: downbeat
achievements.title: Downbeat
achievements.text: Pop a group on the first beat of a bar.

achievements.name: groove
achievements.title: In the Groove
achievements.text: Pop on the beat five shots in a row.
